sections.content: Stored procedures package SQL logic server-side: reusable, transaction-safe, callable from apps with parameters. Functions return values and can be used inside queries.
Trade-offs: less portable across engines, harder to version-control than app code, but they reduce round-trips and enforce business rules centrally.
Key points: parameterize inputs (never concatenate user text — SQL injection), keep procedures focused, and document return shapes clearly.

sections.codeExample:
CREATE PROCEDURE get_user(IN uid INT)
BEGIN
    SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = uid;
END
